blocks.text: Kisi masle ko computer ke zariye hal karne ke liye hamein us ki khasusiyat (characteristics) samajhni hoti hain. Is ka matlab hai teen cheezein pehchanna: inputs, matlooba (desired) outputs, aur woh process jo inputs ko outputs mein badalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Masla 'class ke numbers ka ausat (average) nikalein' ki khasusiyat bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Input: numbers ki list. Process: tamam numbers jama kar ke un ki tadaad se divide karna. Output: ausat (average).

items: Masle ki khasusiyat: inputs, matlooba outputs aur un ke darmiyan ka process.
